system.description:
Rangers who walk at the front of the march with axe, spear and shield: the war-bands of Treaty Hold, and the Keepers who go ahead of the settlers.

  • Reshapes: Hunter's Tricks (Axe and Shield) and your key attribute (Vanguard's Build).
  • Axe and Shield (1st): on a hit with an axe or spear while you carry a shield, you may shove the target 5ft (Strength contest), in place of a Hunter's Trick on that hit.
    • 9th level: you may shove it 10ft, or knock it Prone instead.
  • Shield Charge (1st): once per encounter, when you charge with a shield, you may move through the spaces of creatures your size or smaller; each makes a Reflex save against your Class Save DC or falls Prone.
  • Vanguard's Build (1st): Strength replaces Dexterity as a key attribute, and your 15th-level bonus is +1 Strength instead. Advantage on Strength checks to climb, swim and force obstacles in the wild.
  • Shield Brother (5th): once per round, out of turn, when an ally beside you is hit, you take the hit instead.
